description:
ClippingMini keeps your bookmarks in one private library and lets you use that library from ChatGPT.

Connect the ClippingMini account you already use on the web. After you sign in, you can save a link or a supported chat attachment, search what you have saved, see recent clips, and look through your folders without leaving the chat. Saved links and attachments appear in your ClippingMini library in the web app.

What you can ask
- Save a URL. Add a title or folder only when you specify one.
- Save a supported file attached to the conversation.
- Search your library by keyword or topic, such as an article, product, or reference you saved earlier.
- List recent bookmarks.
- Browse folders before you save a link or search inside one.

Who it is for
Use it when you collect articles, research, references, and other links and want to file or find them while talking to ChatGPT.

What it does not do
The plugin uses the signed-in ClippingMini account for saves, searches, and browsing. It does not create, rename, or delete folders. It only uses your own ClippingMini data. If you are not connected, connect your account first. An email account must be verified in ClippingMini before it can connect.
